testcase.name: Scenario: move-10 automatically advance to Base Point after one selection: tmp/obk-move-single-source/features/sketch/move/scenario.feature:51:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: move-10 automatically advance to Base Point after one selection ✔ Given an editable sketch with eligible geometry ✔ Given Move has Copy and Precise Input off ✔ When the user enables Optimize for Single Selection and clicks the ellipse perimeter ✔ Then Base Point activates without a separate button click ✔ And the status reads Select base point ✔ When the user presses Escape before choosing a base point ✔ Then Move closes and the ellipse remains in its original position
